title: Chrome browser profiles
whyItMatters: Each profile is a separate browsing identity. Profile names and the accounts signed into Chrome show who used this computer and how many separated identities they kept.
source: Chromium user data directory docs, User Data/<profile>/Preferences: https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/docs/user_data_dir.md
notes: Matches the Preferences file that every profile has, so sibling non-profile folders (Crash Reports, ShaderCache, GrShaderCache) are not matched. A profile folder is Default, Profile 1, Profile 2, ...
